en: The postcard depicts a large crowd gathered inside a grand stadium, with dignitaries and people in formal attire—some in traditional Greek clothing—prominently featured in the foreground. The stone seating and architecture are classical, resembling an ancient stadium. Several lines of text in Greek and French appear at the bottom, identifying the event as the entrance of the Kings of Italy and Greece into the stadium in Athens.
